items.claim: Tyara will eventually get Amanda Lemos down.
items.quote: I do think eventually Tyara will get her down.

items.claim: Ty Miller has good boxing combinations, high volume, and a high work rate.
items.quote: his boxing combinations are good. He throws a high volume, high work rate.

items.claim: Ty Miller has underrated power, good speed, and good timing.
items.quote: His speed and timing is very good as well. And I just like how composed he is on the feet.
